final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and added MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All 40 PCs use the recursive resolver on pc40; the existing network connections, addresses, and routes remain unchanged.

The artificial root is on pc1, the `.com`, `.net`, `.edu`, and `.it` zones are on pc2–pc5, and their delegated zones are on pc6–pc16. Existing `kathara/base` images were retained.

Static BIND validation tools were unavailable, and the lab was not started, so resolution remains to be verified at runtime. The MX records identify the requested machines; they do not configure a mail service.
